g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Typical rural Punjab student: Rs 6,600 a year, but the top tenth spend 15.0 times the bottom tenth's level
Source: PSLM 2019–20 person file, household weights and area from the household file.
Sample: students with ed_total > 0 in Punjab rural (N = 9,173); 3 students outside Rs 100–Rs 1,000,000 are excluded from the bars.
Weighting: every bar, median and percentile is weighted by hhweight; bins are 0.1 wide in log10 units.
